abilities.name: Guardian's Reach
abilities.description: Once per encounter, you may spend 6 Hope. If you do, you and all allies within 3 spaces of you gain a bonus to Damage Reduction equal to your Love rank. This bonus lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Wider Net
abilities.description: Guardian's Reach's range increases from 3 spaces to 6 spaces.

abilities.name: Constant Watch
abilities.description: Guardian's Reach can be used once per round.

abilities.name: Sharp Eyes
abilities.description: When you make a Radar check, add 1d4 to the result.

abilities.name: Full Shield
abilities.description: Guardian's Reach's Damage Reduction bonus increases from your Love rank to twice your Love rank.

abilities.name: Never Alone
abilities.description: Once between rests, restore Hope equal to twice your Love rank to every ally.
